_comment: Generated by running measure.py against the small local profile from README.md Step 2 (expand.py --raw-window 1h --span 1d --nodes 3, seed-10min.csv.gz fixture). bytes_per_row is the payload proxy defined in measure.py (LENGTH(metric_name)+LENGTH(labels)+16, plus LENGTH(node) for the cluster table), not on-disk page bytes. file_payload_ratio is (page_count*page_size) / summed payload bytes across all measured tiers -- scale-invariant (confirmed identical at the small 1h/1d profile and the full 24h/14d profile) and, unlike bytes_per_row, sensitive to schema/index bloat that inflates page_count without changing payload. bytes_per_row is fixture-determined and does NOT detect product-side metric/label growth until capture.bash is re-run and this fixture is regenerated -- see test/tsdb-lab/README.md's 'Maintenance' section. Regenerate by re-running the Step 2 flow in README.md and copying the printed bytes/row and ratio values below.
